content.text: also I want to set it up like if chatgpt app is quit, it is still running. what options do we hv got here?

A macOS **LaunchAgent** is the best fit: Clanker runs independently of ChatGPT, restarts after a crash, and starts when you log in.

The other options are a separate Terminal session for manual use, or a cloud host for running while your Mac is off. A LaunchAgent still needs your Mac awake and online.
